**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

Section 18 of the Copperleaf agreement satisfies every preferred element of the INSURANCE rule:

| Element | Where met |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M per occurrence | §18.1 |
| CGL USD 2M aggregate | §18.1 |
| Professional E&O USD 2M | §18.1 |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (Customer Data) | §18.1 — granted unconditionally, so the trigger is satisfied a fortiori (Customer Data is broadly defined at §1.3) |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | §18.1 |
| Certificates on request | §18.2 |

Section 18 also carries extras that favour us and that I did not disturb: employer's liability of USD 1M, a one-year post-term tail, reputable insurers and primary-coverage language, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No other clause in the document limits or conditions these obligations. Since the clause exceeds the preferred checklist and the surplus terms all run in our favour, no change is warranted.
